Story.title: Story
Story.description: An anonymous emotional story planted as a seed in the living meadow.

storyId.description: Unique identifier for the story document.

anonymousId.description: Generated anonymous soul identifier (e.g., Anonymous Soul #1048).

content.description: The anonymous trauma or emotional experience written by the visitor.

seedType.description: The chosen seed archetype for the story.

flowerVariant.description: The visual flower variety rendered in the meadow.

contentWarning.description: Optional content warning note (empty string if none).

moderationStatus.description: Moderation visibility status of the story.

warmthCount.description: Total supportive warmth reactions sent to this flower.

messageCount.description: Total supportive kind messages left on this flower.

positionX.description: Horizontal percentage position in the flower meadow (2 to 98).

positionY.description: Depth percentage position in the flower meadow (5 to 88).

scale.description: Visual scale multiplier for natural variation (0.5 to 1.4).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the seed was planted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the flower was last updated.

Reaction.title: Reaction
Reaction.description: A supportive reaction sent to an anonymous flower.

reactionId.description: Unique identifier for the reaction document.

storyId.description: Parent story ID receiving the warmth reaction.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the reaction was created.

SupportiveMessage.title: SupportiveMessage
SupportiveMessage.description: An anonymous kind message left for a story author.

messageId.description: Unique identifier for the message document.

storyId.description: Parent story ID this message supports.

moderationStatus.description: Moderation status of the supportive message.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was created.

Report.title: Report
Report.description: A content moderation report for harmful or inappropriate submissions.

targetType.description: Whether a story or message is being reported.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the report was submitted.

/stories/{storyId}.description: Top-level collection of anonymous stories planted as flowers in the garden.

/stories/{storyId}/reactions/{reactionId.description: Subcollection of warmth reactions for a specific story.

/stories/{storyId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Subcollection of supportive messages for a specific story.

/reports/{reportId}.description: Collection of moderation reports submitted by visitors.
